request.text: Close-up miniature foley of a small hard chitin shell plate repeatedly being gently pried and released against another dry shell segment. Light crisp brittle clicks, short leathery creaks and fine hard-shell scraping in restrained irregular gathering pulses. Dry intimate recording, tiny game scale. No insect buzzing, creature movement, bones breaking, heavy crunches, metal, footsteps, voices, music or reverb.
